title: Beginners Guide to C# and the .NET Micro Framework
author: Gus Issa
description: An introduction to C# aimed at embedded developers using the .NET Micro Framework, moving from language basics to working with hardware ports, interrupts, and small networked devices. Published by GHI Electronics.
